	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }

			set_variable = { name = oe_amr_dec_pachacuti_tawantinsuyu_done value = 1 }
			add_gold = -120

				limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_amr_adv_qhapaq_nan_engineering } }
				research_advance = advance_type:oe_amr_adv_qhapaq_nan_engineering
			}
			location:qusqu = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_amr_quipu_tambo_archive } }
					construct_building = {
						building_type = building_type:oe_amr_quipu_tambo_archive
						cost_multiplier = 0
						cost_multiplier_reason = oe_amr_pachacuti_free_build_reason
						instant = yes
					}
				}
				every_neighbor_location = {
					limit = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner = { this = root }
						NOT = { has_road_of_type_to = { target = location:qusqu type = road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road } }
					}
					add_road_to = { target = location:qusqu type = oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road }
				}
			}
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_pachacuti_tawantinsuyu_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.8
		}
	}
